question: Inapproximability of Maximum Diameter Clustering for Few Clusters
proof_check: Edges at distance>beta equivalently >=r beta. An induced H gives an r-embedding, so it is forbidden. Color classes exactly match small-diameter clusters, including empty parts. The earlier gap equivalence supplies the available distance<=beta oracle for polynomial construction.
limits: One question already easy for this checkpoint. Constant score gives no within-group policy gradient and is not evidence of improvement.
